criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frames 1, 3, 6 and 9 pass or come close. The mannequin readable at full size on frame 2, frame 4's slabs on empty caliche with the grey bar overhanging zero by about 45 px, frames 7 and 8 flat elevations with no post shadows and empty sky crossed by brackets, frame 5's door still flat and its shadow a hard polygon, frame 9's ridge still a heavy band with a ground seam.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One deck, one world, the 7 to 8 device the clearest. Frame 5 sits outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces, KVIA attributed, 'at first' faithful. Frame 4's 366 bar reads about 0.39 of the beam.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where and the decision named, the stake concrete. No route to act.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Hook earns it, 2 pays, 7 to 8 felt, 9 closes. 6 could move, 4 interrupts the walk.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register. Deks a docket summary, frame 8 dense, place texture only in the art, 1118 without a separator.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Topic new. goldenHour and into the sun as 33, gensets with a person as 32, rail count and one scale as 36, a PUCT docket as 36.
